entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eberhard of Béthune was a Flemish grammarian of the early thirteenth century, from Arras. He was the author of Graecismus, a popular Latin grammatical poem, dated to around 1212. The title derives from a short section on the Greek language.

entities.summary: Eberhard of Béthune was a Flemish grammarian of the early thirteenth century, from Arras. He was the author of Graecismus, a popular Latin grammatical poem, dated to around 1212. The title derives from a short section on the Greek language.
